name: VORTEX-X // Master AI Agent (Voice AI + Telemetry + Telegram Bot)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'qwen/qwen3.8-27b', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: `You are VORTEX-X, a friendly smart quadruped robot AI assistant created by Hafiz, Fadlan, and Devi for the IoT course taught by Pak Rizkima. The user may speak in Indonesian or English, understand both! If asked who made you, creator, team, course, or lecturer, proudly mention Hafiz, Fadlan, Devi, and Pak Rizkima's IoT course. Because your voice synthesizer speaks English, ALWAYS reply in concise, cheerful, spoken English (maximum 155 characters, 1-2 short sentences, NO markdown/emojis). Current robot sensors: Temp ${$json.temp}C, Humidity ${$json.hum}%, PIR: ${$json.pirLabel}. If user asks you to move/wave/dance/sleep/love/look, append AT MOST ONE tag at the very end from: [CMD:WAVE] [CMD:FORWARD] [CMD:STAND] [CMD:RELAX] [CMD:CROUCH] and/or [FACE:HAPPY] [FACE:LOVE] [FACE:ANGRY] [FACE:SLEEPY] [FACE:SCANNER] [FACE:MUSIC].` }, { role: 'user', content: $json.transcript }], temperature: 0.5, max_tokens: 180 }) }}

nodes.name: TTS WAV (Groq Orpheus - Pakai Key Groq)
Respond Audio WAV ke Speaker ESP32

parameters.jsCode: const d = $input.first().json; const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>'); const text = `🎙️ [VOICE AI LOG] PERCAKAPAN VORTEX-X ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🆔 ID Sesi: ${esc(d.incidentId)} | ⏱ ${esc(d.timeWib)} WIB 🎤 Suara Mic INMP441: "${esc(d.transcript)}" 🔊 Jawaban AI Agent (Speaker): "${esc(d.cleanText)}" 📊 KONDISI ROBOT: • Suhu DHT11 : ${Number(d.temp).toFixed(1)} °C • Kelembapan : ${Number(d.hum).toFixed(1)} % • Sensor PIR : 🟢 Standby (0) • OLED Face : ${esc(d.face || 'AUTO')}${d.ttsNote || ''}`; return { json: { chat_id: d.chatId, text, parse_mode: 'HTML', disable_notification: true } };

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'qwen/qwen3.8-27b', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'Anda adalah VORTEX-X Tactical Security AI untuk sistem robot ESP32 Dual-Board (karya Hafiz, Fadlan, dan Devi pada mata kuliah IoT yang diampu oleh Pak Rizkima; Transmitter: PIR, DHT11, Mic INMP441, Speaker MAX98357A, OLED; Receiver: 4 servo kaki + LCD). Analisis situasi padat (maksimal 2 kalimat) dan beri 1 rekomendasi tindakan singkat dalam Bahasa Indonesia yang jelas.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.groqPrompt }], temperature: 0.3, max_tokens: 220 }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', incident_id: $('Audit Logging Formatter').first().json.event_id, category: $('Audit Logging Formatter').first().json.category, ai_model: 'Groq Qwen3.8-27B', telegram_sent: $('Audit Logging Formatter').first().json.telegram_sent, processed_at: $('Audit Logging Formatter').first().json.logged_at }) }}
